title: Cut a rotated sorted array at mid and one half is always sorted
caption: The window is the sorted half. Compare nums[lo] with nums[mid] to tell which half it is.

frames.text: nums[lo] = 6 ≤ nums[mid] = 12, so the left half nums[lo .. mid] is sorted. The break (12 → 1) must be on the right.
Rotated further: nums[lo] = 9 > nums[mid] = 3, so the break is on the left and the right half nums[mid .. hi] is sorted.
